title: Resort Credit Standing on the Household's Pass Account Set Against an Equipment Rental and Demo Settlement
content:
Resort credit issued to a household and not yet drawn is the collective's own money in the household's hands, and it is set against what the counter takes on an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement.

## The rule

Where the household holds a Season Pass Programme pass standing active for the season, and the pass account carries resort credit issued and not yet drawn, the whole of that credit standing is set against what is taken.

Where the household holds no Season Pass Programme pass standing active for the season, and the pass account carries resort credit issued and not yet drawn, that credit standing is set against what is taken up to the inactive credit cap. The inactive credit cap is 50.00 USD.

In any other case nothing is set against what is taken under this heading.

## The two conditions in combination

| Season Pass Programme pass standing active for the season | Resort credit issued and not yet drawn | Set against what is taken |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | some standing | the whole of the credit standing |
| no | some standing | the credit standing, up to 50.00 USD |
| yes | none standing | nothing under this heading |
| no | none standing | nothing under this heading |

The cap bites on the second row only. Where the pass stands active there is no ceiling on the credit that may be set against what is taken.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical settlement

Take a counter figure of 320.25 USD.

- The household's pass stands active for the season and 120.00 USD of credit stands issued and not yet drawn: the whole 120.00 USD is set against what is taken.
- The household holds no pass standing active for the season and 120.00 USD of credit stands issued and not yet drawn: 50.00 USD is set against what is taken, that being the cap.
- The household holds no pass standing active and 30.00 USD of credit stands issued and not yet drawn: 30.00 USD is set against what is taken, the credit standing being below the cap.
- No credit stands issued and not yet drawn: nothing is set against what is taken under this heading.

## Point of judgement

**What the credit standing is.** It is the resort credit the pass account shows as issued less what has been drawn against it, and only a positive figure opens either row.
